FastAPI has become the dominant Python web framework for building high-performance APIs. Its async-first design, automatic OpenAPI documentation generation, and tight Pydantic integration make it a compelling choice for teams that previously relied on Flask or Django REST Framework. Version 0.110 introduced significant improvements to dependency injection ergonomics, reducing boilerplate in large applications. Many teams are now migrating existing synchronous endpoints to async handlers to take advantage of its built-in support for background tasks and WebSocket connections.
